title.suggested: Notice for Tom Allen's saloon at 619 Market Street

summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican carried a notice for Tom Allen's place at 619 Market Street, calling him the retired champion of the world and hero of twenty-four prize battles, with a free-and-easy every evening.

metadata.notes: Masthead: The Republican: St. Louis, Wednesday Morning, June 11, 1884, page 6 (same page as 706). It was the Missouri Republican until 1888.

facts.fact: Allen ran his saloon at 619 Market Street with a free-and-easy every evening, billed as the retired champion of the world and hero of twenty-four prize battles
